work_authorisation_expires_on.title: Work authorisation expires on
work_authorisation_expires_on.description: The day the work pass or permit ends, an extension included.

controls_employer.title: Controls the employer (no perquisite exemptions)
controls_employer.description: LHDN PR 5/2019 para 7.5 and MTD Specification 2026 E(9): the exempt allowances and awards do not apply to an employee with control over the employer.

paternity_confinements.description: One record per confinement, including earlier employers/spouses. Set event_id to the date of its CHILD_BIRTH event. overtime_by_contract.description: First Schedule para 1A takes ss.60(3), 60A(3), 60D(3) from a non-manual employee above RM4,000; true where the contract grants them anyway.

shift_work.title: Shift work
shift_work.description: EA s.60C: normal hours averaged over three weeks.

industrial_training_student.description: EPF Act 1991 s.2, Employees’ Social Security Act 1969 s.2(5) and Employment Insurance System Act 2017 s.2: a person not employed under a contract of service or apprenticeship is not an employee — no EPF, SOCSO, SKBBK or EIS. Declare OTHER for work outside these permitted categories.

hazardous_work.description: Whether the work falls within Act 350 Fourth Schedule machinery, hazardous environment, construction, timber, offshore or near-water work.
